name: Raoul Pal
zh_summary: 他表示按他的算法，每單位能源換到的智能產出效率大約每五個月翻一倍，而且翻倍時間還在縮短，人類歷史沒有東西這樣複利。他稱之為「經濟奇點」，估計 2030 至 2032 年左右機器經濟會快過 GDP、盈利、工資這些量度工具，所以從現在到那時是窗口期，要在舊數字失效前站在稀缺的那邊，「可能只有五年」。附影片，影片內容未看。沒有提及個股。
text:
By my measurement, the efficiency of intelligence output is doubling roughly every five months. 

This isn't the models getting a bit better... this is the actual amount of intelligence you get out of each unit of energy, doubling, every five months... and the doubling time is shrinking.

Nothing in human history has compounded like this. Not electricity, not the internet. And there's no playbook for it, because every institution we have was built for a world where things changed over decades.

This is what I call The Economic Singularity. Somewhere around 2030 to 2032 the machine economy starts moving faster than the instruments we use to measure it... GDP, earnings, the wage were all built for a world of scarce human labour, all pointed at an economy that no longer runs on it. 

Which means the years between now and then are the window. The whole game is to be positioned on the scarce side of the ledger before the old numbers stop meaning anything, because once the machines are running the machine economy the easy part is over. 

We have maybe five years...

ticker_notes.PENG: 轉攻 neocloud，服務毛利 49% 高一倍

zh_summary: 他說 $PENG 開啟了新的不對稱槓桿：以前主攻主權 AI，這次轉攻 neocloud，Q4 6 個新 AI 基建客戶有 4 個是 neocloud；這些 neocloud 很多只是融資公司，簽了算力合約就請 $PENG 交付硬體、搭建基建再維護 5 年，例如挪威 36,000 GPU 工廠（背後有 100 億實驗室承諾）。服務毛利約 49%、硬體約 24%，Q4 服務只佔營收約 10%，擴大會是 EPS 槓桿。附簡報與盤後 69.47 美元截圖。看好。
text:
$PENG just unlocked this brand new asymmetric lever and it's genius.

Previously the company was pushing sovereign AI as the main customer set for their AI infra division but per this ER they're now focused on neoclouds which is a WAY bigger opportunity. 4 of the 6 new AI infrastructure customers in Q4 were neoclouds.

These neoclouds are basically hiring $PENG as the AI factory in a box. Many of these neoclouds aren't full stack and instead just finance shops. They line up the multi-billion dollar compute deal with a hyperscaler or lab and hire $PENG to get them the hardware, set up the infra and maintain it for 5 years. One neocloud just hired them to build and run a 36,000 GPU factory in Norway backed by a $10B lab commit.

This is killer for $PENG because services made about a 49% gross margin last reported quarter, roughly double the 24% on hardware, and those contracts stick around for years. 

Only about 10% of $PENG's revenue in Q4 came from services. But $1 of service revenue generates the same profit as $2 for hardware, meaning this is a strong EPS lever if it scales with these huge cluster deals from neoclouds.

text:
A TON OF THINGS HAPPENED IN THE STOCK MARKET TODAY.

Here's a full recap:

1. SpaceX $SPCX is reportedly seeking $40B in financing, led by Apollo, to fund a massive purchase of NVIDIA $NVDA AI chips, according to the Financial Times. The proposed financing includes roughly $10B in bank loans and $30B of investment-grade debt, with the transaction expected to close in 2027. Elon Musk said in August that SpaceX had “decided to build exclusively on NVIDIA,” specifically highlighting the company's Vera Rubin architecture as SpaceX accelerates investment in AI compute and data center infrastructure.

2. AMD $AMD CEO Lisa Su said AI compute demand continues to outpace supply and expects strong demand to persist for the next several years, with AMD planning to substantially increase supply in 2027. Su said AMD has already expanded supply this year but “could definitely use more,” thanking TSMC for bringing additional manufacturing capacity online while noting that memory remains broadly supply constrained. She added that AMD is working closely with memory suppliers and customers to ensure capacity ramps in sync while keeping its current business model unchanged. Su also described Taiwan as “very critical” to AMD, saying the company plans to increase its investment there while continuing to explore new packaging technologies.

3. Uber $UBER is acquiring ezCater for $2.3B in cash, expanding Uber Eats into the workplace catering market. ezCater has more than 140,000 restaurant partners

name: Raoul Pal
zh_summary: 他說智慧成本與能源成本同時崩跌：token 成本、每瓦成本、每單位能源換得的智慧都在下跌，越便宜用得越多（傑文斯悖論），Wright 定律與 Metcalfe 定律互相疊加；AI 已經在建造 AI，再轉幾輪速度會超乎想像。影片內容未看。沒有提及個股。
text:
The cost of intelligence is collapsing. The cost of energy is collapsing. The cost of a token, the cost of a watt, the amount of intelligence you get out of every unit of energy... all of it is falling at once.

And cheaper is what makes the whole thing go exponential. 

Jevons paradox... make something cheaper and the world finds a thousand new uses for it. Every time intelligence gets cheaper, we use more of it, which pays for the next round of getting cheaper. Wrights Law and Metcalfes Law running into each other.

We're at the very start of that and AI is already building AI...

Play it forward a few turns of the wheel and the speed of it goes beyond anything we can picture... intelligence being used in volumes we cant imagine, to build things we haven't even dreamed up yet.

text:
The employment downturn in the US Information sector is intensifying:

Information employment fell another -10,000 jobs in September, to 2.739 million, the lowest since December 2020.

Excluding the 2020 pandemic drop, this is the lowest level since December 2014.

In total, the Information industry has shed -376,000 jobs, or -12.1%, since the November 2022 peak.

To put this into perspective, during the 2001 recession and its aftermath, Information employment fell -568,000 jobs, or -15.3%, from March 2001 to December 2003.

The Information sector is losing jobs at a crisis pace.
